stories.title: Flintshire speed cameras issued more than 20,000 fines in 2025
stories.summary: Eight of the ten busiest speed cameras in North Wales are sited in Flintshire, with a single camera on the A5104 at Pontybodkin issuing more than 4,300 fixed penalty notices to drivers in 2025. stories.title: “Children will be pushed into exile”: Saltney campaigners on Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: Opponents of plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire to create a 3-18 super-school say it undermines the new Welsh Government’s commitment to strengthen Welsh culture. stories.title: Flintshire leader Dave Hughes eyes re-election at last AGM before polls
stories.summary: Councillor Dave Hughes will ask Flintshire County Council to back him as leader for another year on Tuesday, at the chamber’s last annual meeting before next May’s elections. stories.title: New Welsh Government urged to prioritise mental health prevention as Awareness Week begins
stories.summary: More than two-thirds of adults in Wales used harmful actions to cope with poor mental health in the past month, a new poll suggests.
